what: Nextra is a docs framework, not a general UI framework. It only scans .mdx files for page routing — .jsx/.tsx pages won't be found by the _meta.js system. To use custom JSX components as pages, wrap them: create the component in components/, then import it from an .mdx file. Use layout: 'raw' in _meta.js to remove docs chrome (sidebar, toc) from landing pages.
why: Spent time debugging build failures when trying to use .jsx as a Nextra page — Nextra 3 ignores non-mdx files in its routing.
